name: Rapid chain of transfers between retirement schemes or providers
description: A retirement balance moves through several schemes, providers or trustees in a short period without a stated reason, often ending in an account or product with weaker oversight.
fp: Members change providers for fees, consolidation or after job moves, and legitimate consolidation can involve several transfers.

links.name: Rapid chain of transfers between retirement schemes or providers
links.ctx: Several transfers in or out of a scheme within weeks, ending in a scheme or trustee that is newly set up or overseas.
